rear_passage.method: VTK OBBTree line intersections with the exact fluid STL; sorted crossings paired from an exterior start; repeated edge hits deduplicated at 1e-7 mm. No remeshing.

limitations: Euler is calculated from exactly coincident vertex indexing without merging by tolerance or facet removal.
Prefix topology uses unmodified existing facets entirely below the cut; it localizes handles approximately, without clipped/capped meshes.
Line sampling gives observed passage thicknesses, not a proven global minimum or boundary-layer resolution.
No topology gate or mesh has been changed.
